purpose: Teach: 探っ/効か/呪い/治っ/振ら/古今/身元/速攻

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、隠された動機、探ってますね。
lines.en: Your paper — you're really probing into the hidden motivations behind it.
lines.style: Measured, observant opening. Slight pause after the dash. Warm curiosity, not interrogation. Leaning forward slightly with genuine interest in his approach.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。対策が効かない地域、章にしました。
lines.en: Yes. I made regions where countermeasures weren't working into their own chapter.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Matter-of-fact about the structural choice, but underneath — pride in having found the right framework. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統的な呪いの研究、独創的な視点ですね。
lines.en: Drawing on traditional curse research but finding your own angle — that's genuinely original work.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Genuine appreciation, not flattery. Slight warm emphasis on 「original」. Speaking as someone who recognizes real scholarship.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 歴史的トラウマが治った例、章末で扱いました。
lines.en: I addressed historical traumas that actually healed — treated that in the final chapter.
lines.style: Careful precision. He's defending a choice that matters to him. Not defensive, but quietly firm. Slight pause before 「healed」 — he's chosen that word deliberately.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: メディアに振らされない研究姿勢、評価できます。
lines.en: I really respect that your work doesn't let itself get pushed around by what the media wants.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate respect. Each phrase lands. Not overstated — this is a real observation about his integrity. Warm but serious undertone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 古今の事例を組み合わせて、説得力、出ました。
lines.en: By bringing together old and new case studies, the arguments actually started to click into place.
lines.style: Modest satisfaction in the voice. Slight brightness on 「click into place」 — relief that the structure worked. Still earnest, not self-congratulatory.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 被害者の身元、匿名化、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: And you were really careful about anonymizing the victims' identities — that showed real thoughtfulness.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Slow on 「anonymizing」. She's recognizing something that takes character, not just skill. Gentle affirmation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 速攻での発表、評価された場面でした。
lines.en: Getting it out there quickly but still getting it right — that was a moment worth celebrating.
lines.style: Closing warmth. Slight lift at the end, like she's bookending the conversation with genuine encouragement. Calm but affirming. The period holds.
